name: Royal Caribbean Group
outlook:
What Royal Caribbean Group says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted earnings per shareBased on current fuel pricing, interest rates, currency exchange rates and the factors detailed above, the company expects fourth quarter Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $3.48 to $3.58.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted earnings per shareAdjusted EPS is expected to be in the range of $17.85 to $17.95.
  • Full year 2026: revenue and net yieldsRevenue is expected to grow 9% year over year. Net Yields are expected to increase approximately 2.7% as-reported and approximately 2.1% in Constant Currency.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures for the full year 2026 are expected to be approximately $4.6 billion, based on current foreign exchange rates, and are predominantly related to the company's new ship order book and land-based destination initiatives.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
